what_this_is: The pinned per-root verdict of crates/clean-compiler/examples/trustcg_census.rs (FULL scope), compared row by row by scripts/check_trustcg_census.py in the `trustcg-census` gate leg (opt-in: CLEAN_TRUSTCG_CENSUS=1 + TRUSTCG_BIN). Any changed, missing or new row -- or a failing row whose normalised REASON changed -- fails the leg by name; re-pin with --write-expected in the commit that explains the change. A failing verdict is `<TAG> ~<id>`, citing `reasons`.
measured_at: 2026-10-19 (round-10 repair of the round-4 red sweep): clean 1bbc6e6a8 (fix/red-sweep-20261016 merged with origin/main ccb6c1ab0), FULL scope, --release, aarch64-apple-darwin; trust-cg 0.7.0 debug build of trust-cg e5560e8db (the rev Clean's lock pins since ed11049a0; scratch worktree, own target dir). 1146 verdicts: 0 OK, 1145 TRUSTCG_FAIL on the codegen license (an ungated body), 1 LOWER_FAIL. Reviewed re-pin of 110 differences against the 2026-09-29 pin (clean 61ee09d10, trust-cg 0.6.0 07dc5c153), each by a measured cause: (1) the trust-cg move 0.6.0 -> 0.7.0 changes NO row -- the census of clean 61ee09d10 run with this trust-cg reproduces all 1049 pinned verdicts and reasons (only the version line differs); (2) 97 NEW roots, all TRUSTCG_FAIL on the license except Except.instMonad (LOWER_FAIL: the root does not compile from source), placed by population dumps of the census at clean 61ee09d10 / 6a61c8c6c / 6ef3be510 (86 entered by 6a61c8c6c, 11 after) and attributed to the commit whose diff introduces each name's current definition (git log -S over the range; for the 19 none -> computable roots, the definition that made them lowerable): 63442b5bd (Fin.add/div/mod/mul/sub, Fin.instAdd/Mul/Sub, instHDivFin, instHModFin), dac65e243 (instToStringFloat), 07af1999b (the Lean monad family: Pure.pure, Bind.bind, Applicative.toPure, Monad.toApplicative/toBind, Id/Except/ExceptT/OptionT/StateT instMonad and their bind/pure, ExceptT/OptionT/StateM and their mk/run/fail/get/set/modify/modifyGet, MonadExcept.throw/tryCatch, instMonadExcept{Except,ExceptT,StateT}, instMonadIO, instMonadOption, Except.instMonad), 2291e9cd7 (instHAdd/HSub/HMul/HDiv/HMod, Nat.instDiv/instMod), ae7216ffb (Div.div, Mod.mod, UInt8.instOfNat, instDivUInt8), c4bd332a1 (instBEqProd, instReprOption), 80f52d4e5 (Clean.instReprProdOfRepr), 0775b9f21 (Int.instMax/Min), 7c5e4fbdb (instLinearOrderNat, instPartialOrderNat), a8d0b5b51 (Int.div, Int.mod: opaque -> computable); the other 30 are the casesOn/recOn/noConfusion/noConfusionType auxiliaries of the classes those commits added (Applicative, Monad, MonadExcept, Div, Mod), Applicative.toFunctor/toSeq/toSeqLeft/toSeqRight, and UInt{16,32,64}.instOfNat / instDivUInt{16,32,64} beside their UInt8 twins, which no name search places on one commit; (3) 12 REASON CHANGED rows, exactly the twelve UInt{8,16,32,64}.toUInt{8,16,32,64}: still TRUSTCG_FAIL on the same ungated-body refusal, but the first ungated function trust-cg names moved from the root to UInt{N}.toNat._boxed_const_0, measured to flip exactly across 9c3b07253 (WS6.10, which defines every <B>.toUInt<C> x as <C>.ofNat (<B>.toNat x)): with this trust-cg, the census at its parent d474a5cec gives all twelve the pinned reason and the census at 9c3b07253 names the helper for all twelve, with no other row different (1135 rows at both). Logs: ~/scratch.noindex/round10-20261019/clean-sweep-repair-logs (census-*.tsv/log) and round4-20261016/clean-sweep-logs/census-pop.
